event_text: 1984 Hosting suspends all its services after what it and CERT-IS call a serious cyberattack
notes: When the attackers first got in has not been said.

event_text: 1984's managing director tells Vísir that the seven damaged websites appear to support Palestine
1984 says its investigation found customer data untouched except on the seven targeted websites
Iceland's Civil Protection and CERT-IS activate the national response plan for essential information infrastructure
1984 says email is working again and expects the first websites back from about 21:00 UTC
